verdict.rationale: A runtime probe confirms Yubico runs YubiEnterprise 'YubiKey as a Service' with live, public REST API docs at console.yubico.com/apidocs/, covering fleet delivery, inventory and shipment management, which matches an API- or console-driven delivery service. The evidence is a single probe that verified only the page title, so the shipping workflow itself is barely documented. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on direct-to-employee shipping workflows (address handling, international reach, tracking), any evidence of console UI features, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the delivery service.
